reason: The first outcome-blind corpus build excluded RSS descriptions containing presentation HTML. CFTC RSS embeds valid prose inside tags such as b and br; the frozen contract requires plain-text title and description.

rule.operation: Parse HTML fragments with Python HTMLParser; preserve character data; insert spaces at br, p, div, and li boundaries; decode character references; collapse whitespace; reject only when required text is empty after normalization.

selection_effect: No keyword, topic, date, market, label, return, or model-output filter is introduced.
